body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within 4 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, pull each target 1 unit toward a visible point between them. Choose one hit target to take 1 Cold Damage.

surges.html: Each hit target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Water Thread
rider.html: Gain a Water Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: suppress one ordinary Movement penalty on yourself or one willing target of that card until the start of your next turn.
